IC.IC2: S. aureus on at least 1 blood culture within 72 hours of beginning study drug (Cohort A) OR

EC.EC1: 1. For subjects in Cohort A: previous therapy for more than 48 hours with any parenteral antibiotic with activity against S. aureus within 72 hours of positive blood culture results.

EC2.EC2.1: 2. For subjects in Cohort B: previous therapy for more than 48 hours with any parenteral antibiotic with activity against MRSA,
EC2.EC2.2: except vancomycin and/or daptomycin, within 72 hours of positive blood culture results confirming persistence.

EC.EC3: 3. Previous episode of S. aureus bacteremia within 3 months.
